question: Which statement best distinguishes Lua patterns from many common regex engines?
options: Lua patterns have their own smaller syntax and should not be assumed to support every PCRE feature
Lua patterns always support lookbehind and named groups
Lua patterns are identical to JavaScript regular expressions
Every Lua pattern is compiled by PCRE
answer_key: Lua patterns have their own smaller syntax and should not be assumed to support every PCRE feature
explanation: Lua patterns are a distinct pattern language; verify the supported constructs rather than assuming full PCRE compatibility.
